title: Figure 2. Quantum dot in graphene nanoribbon (gate device schematic)
description: Color 3D schematic of a graphene nanoribbon on a red back gate, with two blue regions labeled "Barrier1" and "Barrier2" and a central red "Gate" over an orange lattice region of width W and length L, with x-y axes marked. Caption explains that two barrier gates (blue) define the rectangular quantum dot and a back gate (red) shifts its energy levels. Captioned "Figure 2. Quantum dot in graphene nanoribbon."
